{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sym-voyage''' was a form of [[virtual reality]] simulation that was popular during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The simulation allowed patrons to visit any number of remote, exotic, or popular planets without actually leaving their homeworld. The simulations contained a wide spectrum of "reality," depending on how much an individual was willing to pay for the experience.
